extName.description: The extension's name. A proper noun — leave it as it is in every locale.

extDescription.message: Read manga on any site in a clean reader, and keep one library across your devices.
extDescription.description: The one-line description shown in the Chrome Web Store and on chrome://extensions.

commandToggleReader.message: Show or hide the reader on this page
commandToggleReader.description: What Alt+R does, as listed on chrome://extensions/shortcuts.

actionUse.description: Button that copies what a tracker holds into the form being filled in.

placeholderNone.description: Stands in for an empty field. Lower case: it sits greyed out inside an input, not on a label.

chipNone.description: The chip that clears a choice — no language, no date, no score. A button, so it is capitalised where placeholderNone is not.

untitled.description: Shown where a series title should be but the page gave none.

signedInAs.description: Followed by the account's email address, in bold, on the same line.

modeToastVertical.description: Flashed for a moment when the reader opens, so the reading direction is known before the first tap.

actionForgotPassword.description: Link under the sign-in buttons. It opens the web app, where the reset form lives.

optionsAccountHint.message: An account carries your library, your progress and your history between this computer, your phone and the web app. Without one, everything stays on this computer — which works, and is a choice.

optionsLanguageAuto.description: First entry in the language picker. The other entries are language names, written in their own language, and are not translated.

optionsLanguageHint.message: Applies to the popup, the reader and this page. Pages already open keep the old language until they are reloaded.

optionsOpenInApp.message: Open these settings in the PanelFlow app →

optionsBackendHint.message: Detection rules, library sync and progress sync are served from here. Point it at http://localhost:8787 to work against a backend of your own.
optionsBackendHint.description: Carries a <code> element. Keep the tag and the address inside it unchanged.

optionsThemeHint.message: Follows your account: change it here and the website and the phone app change too. “Follow the system” is also an answer — pick it and each device asks the machine it is on. The reader has its own answer below.

optionsReaderHint.message: Alt+R shows or hides the reader on any detected page. Everything else — brightness, page gap, strip width — is set in the reader itself, on the chapter you are looking at.

optionsAutoShow.message: Open the reader by itself on a chapter page
optionsAutoShow.description: The global default. The toolbar popup can override it for one site.

optionsAutoNext.message: Go on to the next chapter at the end of one

optionsHideRead.message: Hide chapters already read from the chapter list

optionsReaderDark.message: Keep the reader dark, whatever the theme
optionsReaderDark.description: On by default. Off hands the reader to the system's light/dark setting.

optionsTapSides.message: On either third of the screen

optionsTapHint.message: Narrow edges are for reading with a finger on the screen, where a tap in the middle is usually meant for the panel and not for turning the page.

optionsUpdatesHint.message: Only while the browser is running. The server keeps watching the sites it can reach on its own, and hands over what it found the next time the extension asks — so checking rarely costs less than it looks.

optionsAllSites.message: Let PanelFlow run on every site

optionsAllSitesHint.message: PanelFlow only runs on the sites it knows about, and asks for anything else from the toolbar, site by site. Turn this on for a site it has not learned yet, or if covers and chapter downloads fail on a site that otherwise works — those images usually come from a separate domain no site list mentions.

optionsWhitelistLabel.message: Whitelisted domains (one per line — adblock disabled there)

optionsAdblockHint.message: A filter list ships with the extension and is replaced by a newer one from the backend when there is one — no extension update needed. Whitelisting a domain covers its subdomains and every request its pages make.

optionsReplayHint.message: Lost? Run the setup again — it walks through pinning the button, when the reader opens, and whether to keep a library on this computer or on an account.
optionsReplayHint.description: Carries the link that reopens the setup tour. Keep the <a> element and its id exactly as they are; translate only the words.

welcomeSkip.message: Continue without an account for now

welcomeStep1Lede.message: Chrome hides new extensions behind the puzzle-piece icon. Click it, then click the pin next to PanelFlow.

welcomeStep1Hint.message: That button opens your library, your reading statistics and the list of sites. The reader also opens with <kbd>Alt</kbd> + <kbd>R</kbd> on any page.
welcomeStep1Hint.description: Carries two <kbd> elements around the shortcut. Keep the tags; the keys themselves are the same on every keyboard this ships to.

welcomeThemeHint.message: The page changes as you choose. Your account keeps this setting, so the website and the mobile app will look the same.

welcomeStep2Lede.message: PanelFlow works out whether the page you are on is a chapter. You decide what happens next, and you can change it site by site from the toolbar button.

welcomeAutoOnBody.message: You arrive on a chapter, the reader is already open. Recommended.

welcomeAutoOffBody.message: The page stays as it is until you press <kbd>Alt</kbd>+<kbd>R</kbd> or use the toolbar button.
welcomeAutoOffBody.description: Carries two <kbd> elements around the shortcut.

welcomeDirectionHint.message: A site that declares its own direction takes priority, and any change you make inside the reader is remembered.

welcomeStep3Lede1.message: PanelFlow keeps your library, your progress and your saved chapters on your account. That is what lets you find them again in another browser and in the mobile app.

welcomeStep3Lede2.message: It is also what lets our server watch your series for new chapters while Chrome is closed. Setup continues as soon as you are signed in.

welcomeLibraryFollows.description: Finishes the sentence begun by signedInAs and the email in bold — it starts with a full stop on purpose.

welcomeStep4Lede.message: PanelFlow has no catalogue of its own: it reads the site you are already on. Select the ones you use. They are saved to your account and shown first in the extension and on the website.

welcomeSitesUnavailable.message: The rules server did not answer, so there is no list to show. PanelFlow still recognises chapters on its own: open a manga site and press Alt+R.

authNoAnswer.message: No answer from the server — check the API URL in the options.

popupUnreadTitle.message: Only series with a chapter you have not read

popupLibraryEmpty.message: Nothing yet. Add entries to your library from any compatible site.

webSitesLede.message: PanelFlow has no catalogue of its own: it reads the site you are already on. These are the sites it ships tuned rules for, and it detects most others by itself. Star the ones you use and they come first here and in the extension.

webSitesUnavailable.message: The list could not be loaded. PanelFlow still recognises chapters on its own.

popupSitesLede.message: PanelFlow has no fixed list — any page that looks like a chapter is detected automatically, so a site does not need to appear here to work. These are the ones it already knows about.

popupIntroWhat.message: PanelFlow spots chapters on scan sites and opens them in a reader of its own — one set of controls, whatever the site looks like.

popupIntroWhere.message: On a chapter page the reader button appears on the page itself, and <kbd>Alt+R</kbd> opens it from anywhere. This window is the PanelFlow icon in the toolbar — pin it and it stays there.
popupIntroWhere.description: Keep the <kbd> element around the shortcut; translate only the words.

popupIntroAccount.message: Your library, your place in each chapter and your statistics are kept on your account, so you find them again on another computer and in the mobile app. Create an account to get started.
popupIntroAccount.description: Carries the link to the settings page. Keep the <a> element and its id exactly as they are; translate only the words.

popupBadgeTuned.description: On a site in the compatible-sites list: PanelFlow ships extraction rules written for it.

popupBadgeInLibrary.description: On a site in the compatible-sites list: it is only there because the user follows a series from it.

popupNoAccountBody.message: Your library is on this computer only, and new chapters are not being watched for while Chrome is closed. An account fixes both.

standUnread.message: Not caught up — there is something here to read

pageStateNoTab.message: No page in front — open a chapter first.

pageStateScheme.message: PanelFlow does not run on browser pages.

pageStateUnreachable.message: PanelFlow has not loaded on this tab — reload it.

pageStateUndetected.message: No chapter found on this page.

pageStateUngranted.message: PanelFlow does not run on this site yet — turn it on here.

chapterBadge.description: The chapter number on a library tile. $1 is the number. Tight on space — no room for a long word.

chapterN.description: A chapter by number, with room around it. $1 is the number, or an em dash when nothing has been read.

chaptersShort.description: How many chapters a tracker has recorded. $1 is the count.

sinceDate.description: When a tracker says the series was started. $1 is a date.

actionReadChapter.description: Tooltip on a cover that opens a chapter never read before. $1 is the chapter label.

actionContinueChapter.description: Tooltip on a cover that resumes where reading stopped. $1 is the chapter label.

badgeNewChapter.description: Badge on a tile with an unread chapter. $1 is the chapter label.

badgeNew.description: The same badge when the chapter has no label to show.

durationHours.description: A duration over an hour. $1 is whole hours, $2 is minutes padded to two digits.

toastNotReadable.message: Not a readable page — reload it and retry.

toastWakingUp.message: The extension is still waking up — try again.

toastBackendDown.message: $1 is not responding — check the API URL in the options.

trackerConnectedAs.description: $1 is the username on the tracker.

trackerPasswordAuth.message: Asks for a password rather than a permission page — not supported

trackerImportPending.description: Second press of the import button. $1 is how many series would be added, $2 how many would be filled in.

trackerUpToChapter.description: Tacked onto a linked series' line. $1 is the last chapter the tracker holds.

trackerNothingMissing.message: $1 has nothing this library is missing

trackerImportPreview.message: $1 to add · $2 to fill in — press again
trackerImportPreview.description: What a dry-run import found. Nothing has been written yet.

trackerNotListening.message: — nothing is sent to it yet
trackerNotListening.description: Tacked onto "Connected" for a service PanelFlow can sign in to but cannot push progress to.

trackerRefusing.description: $1 is the tracker's own words. A push happens while you read, so this is the only place it is ever said.

trackerFetchedAhead.message: $1 brought up to date · $2 further along there than here
trackerFetchedAhead.description: $2 series the tracker has read more of than PanelFlow knows about. Nothing was changed for them: a tracker counts chapters and a bookmark is a page on a site.

statsLoadError.message: Statistics could not be loaded: $1. What you read on this device is kept below.
statsLoadError.description: $1 is the error the server or the network gave.

statsLocalOnly.message: Counted on this device. An account adds up every device you read on — and keeps more than the last few thousand chapters.

statAverageOfN.description: $1 is how many entries carry a score.

statDays.description: A streak length. $1 is a number of days.

reportWhatWentWrong.description: The line left for the user to answer in a new GitHub issue. Everything else in the issue stays English so it can be triaged.

readerHiddenOne.description: Why the chapter wheel is short. $1 is always 1 here; the many form is a separate key.

readerHelpTap.message: Tap a side to turn the page, the middle for the controls — long strip scrolls instead
readerHelpTap.description: One line of the help list. The <b> marks the gesture being named.

readerHelpPinch.message: Pinch or ctrl+wheel to zoom, drag to move — the view never snaps back

readerHelpDoubleTap.message: Double tap to zoom in on a panel, again to fit the page

readerHelpArrows.message: ← → space turn the page · ↑ ↓ scroll the long strip

readerHelpWheel.message: C the chapter wheel — scroll or ↑ ↓ to find one, enter to open it
readerHelpWheel.description: The letter keys are the shortcuts themselves and do not change with the language.

readerHelpKeys1.message: S preferences · B break the first page · 0 reset zoom

readerHelpKeys2.message: F full screen · H hide the controls · ? this list · Esc close

readerHelpNote.message: Reading direction, tap zones and everything else live under ⚙.

readerSeriesPrefs.description: A switch above the reading mode. Off, the panel edits the settings every series opens with; on, it edits this series only.

readerSeriesOn.message: These settings now follow this series

readerEndOf.description: $1 is the chapter label as the site wrote it — "Chapter 42", "42.5".

readerEndCaughtUp.message: That is the newest chapter here.

readerEndLeftOne.description: How many chapters this site still lists after this one — not how many the series has.

pillReaderModeTitle.message: PanelFlow: open this chapter in Reader Mode

modalSameTitleLead.message: You already follow this series on another site.

modalLikelyLead.message: This looks like a series you already follow.

modalCloseTitlesWarning.message: The titles are close but not identical — check this is really the same series before migrating.

modalKeepsProgress.message: Your progress, score, notes and tags

modalKeepsOldSite.message: The old site, kept in the entry’s history

modalAddTagHint.message: Add a tag and press Enter

modalLocalOnlyHint.message: Saved on this device only — sign in from the PanelFlow extension settings to see it in the web app.

modalConnectTrackerLead.message: Connect a tracker to fill this in from your own list:

modalConnectTrackerHint.message: Connect AniList or MyAnimeList in the PanelFlow web app to fill this in from your own list.

modalNoTitle.message: Could not read a title on this page.

offlineEmpty.message: Nothing saved yet. Open a chapter, then press 📥 in the reader's side bar to keep it on this device.
offlineEmpty.description: Carries a <code> around the button's icon. Keep the tag and the icon.

offlineUsage.message: $1 · $2 on this device · kept for $3 days
offlineUsage.description: $1 is a chapter count already worded, $2 a size such as “12 MB”, $3 a number of days.

notifyNewChapterBody.description: $1 is the series title, $2 the chapter number, $3 the site it appeared on.

webForgotLede.message: We'll email you a link to choose a new password.

webImportTitle.message: Import a list from AniList or MyAnimeList

webExportTitle.message: Download a backup, or restore one

webMoveSiteTitle.message: Move every series off a dead site

webLibraryEmpty.message: Nothing here yet. Add a series, or pin one from the PanelFlow extension while browsing your favorite manga site.

webCheckUpdatesTitle.message: Re-scan every series for new chapters

webUpdatesEmpty.message: Nothing new. Every series you are following is read up to its latest chapter.

webStatsEmpty.message: Nothing read yet. Reader Mode in the extension records reading time as you go.

webTrackersLede.message: Every chapter you finish is sent to the accounts below. PanelFlow only ever writes the chapter count, and only ever forwards.

webNoLinksYet.message: Nothing linked yet. A series finds itself on the tracker the first time you read a chapter of it.

webThemeHint.message: Follows your account: change it here and the extension and the phone app change too. If the desk you read at and the phone in your pocket do not want the same answer at the same hour, that is what “Follow the system” is for — it is a choice, and each device asks the machine it is on.

webLanguageHint.message: Follows your account, and applies here as much as in the extension and the phone app.

webAccountHint.message: Your library, your progress and your trackers follow this address.

webPasswordHint.message: We send a link to your address, and the link is what changes the password — so a browser someone else left signed in cannot change it.

webNoExtension.message: These settings live in the PanelFlow extension, which this browser does not have. Install it and this section fills in.

webReadingDirectionHint.message: How a chapter opens, unless the site says otherwise.

webCheckEveryHint.message: How often the extension looks, in the background.

webWhitelistHint.message: One domain per line. Ads are not blocked on these — for a site that breaks when they are.

webImportLede.message: Adds what is missing and fills in blanks. Nothing already in your library is overwritten.

webFromConnected.message: From an account you have connected:

webExportLede.message: The backup holds everything — shelf, bookmarks and reading history — and is the only format that can be restored here.

webRestoreLede.message: Fills in what is missing. Nothing already in your library is overwritten.

webShelvesLede.message: A shelf is a tab of your own. It still counts as one of the five reading statuses — that is what decides whether PanelFlow watches those series for new chapters, and what they export as.

webForgotSent.message: If that address has an account, a link is on its way.

webLinkOnItsWay.message: A link is on its way to your inbox.

webPasswordChanged.message: Password changed — sign in with your new one.

webChaptersAhead.message: The latest chapter is $1 ahead of your bookmark

webNewChapterOut.message: A chapter you have not read yet is out

webMakeShelf.message: Make a shelf of your own

webShelfStatusHint.message: What this shelf counts as: whether its series are watched for new chapters, and what they export as

webShelfRemoveHint.message: Remove this shelf — its series move to $1

webPageUnreadable.message: Could not read the page ($1) — fill in manually.

webClearHistoryConfirm.message: Delete every recorded read? Your library and bookmarks are not touched.

webMigrateSearching.message: Searching the new site for each series — this takes a while…

webExtensionSilent.message: The extension did not answer — try again.

webSavedHereOnly.message: Saved here, but the account did not hear about it.

webTrackerRefusingFix.message: . Disconnecting and connecting again usually fixes it.

webOngoingHint.message: The series is still being published

trackerSendMyLibraryHint.message: Bring the tracker up to date with every bookmark you already have

trackerFetchAllHint.message: Read your chapter counts back from the tracker, so PanelFlow stops below what you have already read there. Your bookmarks are not touched.

trackerDisconnectConfirm.message:
Disconnect $1?

Nothing is removed from your tracker. PanelFlow forgets which series matched which, so reconnecting starts the matching over.

trackerNoMatch.message: $1 · no match found — pick it yourself

trackerRematchHint.message: Match this one again from scratch on the next chapter you read

webPopupBlocked.message: the browser blocked the window — allow popups for this site

webNoGunzip.message: this browser cannot unzip .gz — unzip the export first

webImportNeedsSource.message: give an AniList username or pick a MyAnimeList export

webPlanCounts.message: $1 to add · $2 to fill in · $3 already up to date

webMigrateTruncated.message: the search ran out of time — run it again for the rest

webPushBlocked.message: This browser is blocking notifications for PanelFlow — allow them in the site settings

webPushOnHint.message: New chapters are announced even when PanelFlow is closed. Click to stop.

webPushOffHint.message: Be told about new chapters even when PanelFlow is closed

webPushExpiredOne.message: $1 subscription had expired and was removed

webPushExpiredN.message: $1 subscriptions had expired and were removed

webPushUnreachableOne.message: $1 browser could not be reached — try again later

webPushUnreachableN.message: $1 browsers could not be reached — try again later

webPushKeysHint.message: . If no notification appears, the server’s keys are wrong.

mobileLibraryEmpty.message: Nothing here yet. Search for a series, open it, and add it from the reader.

mobileSearchPlaceholder.message: Search the web for a series

mobileSearchHint.message: PanelFlow does not host or index anything. This is a plain web search over your own words — each result is checked to tell you whether Reader Mode will work there before you open it.

mobileSearchNeedsAccount.message: Search runs on the PanelFlow backend — sign in on the Account tab first.

mobileVerdictUnlikely.message: Reader Mode probably will not work

mobileStatsSignedOut.message: Statistics live on your account — sign in on the Account tab to see them. What you read on this phone is kept below either way.

mobileAccountHint.message: Your library works fully offline and signed out. An account only adds sync between your phone and your browser, and powers search.

welcomeSitesHint.message: Each site you select opens in a new tab, and this page stays open. These are the sites PanelFlow ships tuned rules for; it detects most others on its own. You can come back to this list from the settings.

mobileNoBridge.message: Opened outside the app: there is no native bridge here, so there is no library to show.
